important_limits: Weight origins/training corpora are not inferable from loaded adapter names or heads alone; attaching new CSVs does not retrain these weights.
Global five-fold-plus-full LoRA log-prob averages cannot be treated as OOF merely by splitting official rows afterwards.
Gaussian uses official data features from the full-data adapter; runtime fitting only on official rows does not remove upstream exposure.
Source sample weights are not overall source mixture percentages: source sizes differ and TF-IDF fitting is unweighted.
COMP and ATLAS nominally enabled but actual hidden-run participation/coverage requires logs, not source inspection alone.
Comments mentioning 10% ATLAS or Hungarian are stale relative to executed arguments 20% and post=0.
Changing public pools affects runtime statistical members immediately but not already-trained adapter/encoder/ATLAS weights.
